items.summary: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution. CISA 要求: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

items.title: Zoho ManageEngine — Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability (CVE-2020-10189)
items.summary: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution. CISA 要求: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

items.title: Zoho ManageEngine — Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability (CVE-2019-8394)
items.summary: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization. CISA 要求: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

items.title: Zyxel Multiple Products — Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability (CVE-2020-29583)
items.summary: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password. CISA 要求: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

meta.recommended_action_zh: 优先级置顶处理: 参考厂商公告尽快打补丁, 排查资产暴露面, 验证修复后关闭相关管理端口。
